As an SDE 1 on this team, you will contribute to the design, development, testing, deployment, and operation of security\-focused software systems that help identify and mitigate vulnerabilities across AI\-integrated applications.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of AI safety, security research, and platform engineering within one of Amazon's most innovative organizations.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Platform Development \& Feature Delivery
   

  

* Design, implement, test, deploy, and maintain security\-focused features for the vulnerability auditing and review platform.
* Build and extend vulnerability detection capabilities for LLM\-integrated services and tools including foundational models, MCP servers, agents, and agent skills/capabilities.
* Deliver working software features end\-to\-end, working backwards from customer requirements through production deployment and ongoing operations.
* Refactor and deprecate existing systems as the platform evolves, ensuring long\-term maintainability and extensibility.


 Security \& AI Safety Engineering
   

  

* Develop automated scanning and analysis tooling to identify security vulnerabilities in AI\-integrated software components.
* Implement detection mechanisms for adversarial attacks, prompt injection, capability boundary violations, and other LLM\-specific threat vectors.
* Collaborate with applied scientists to translate AI safety research into production\-grade platform features.
* Apply secure coding practices and threat modeling to all platform components.


 Operational Excellence
   

  

* Own operational health of your features — monitor, alarm, triage, and resolve production issues.
* Identify root causes of operational failures and implement permanent fixes; never settle for the status quo.

* Design software solutions that bring clarity to difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks.

We want to keep earning trust, while also continuing to amaze our users with the tools they can build in Notion.
   

  

 The Data Product Platform team is responsible for designing, implementing, scaling and operating systems, tools and frameworks to build event\-based or data powered product experiences. You’ll join a team of talented engineers in our mission to build the best in class foundational platforms that are key to the company’s business and product. Notion’s platforms and infrastructure are vital to enabling our product features like search, automations, user notifications, workspace analytics and Notion AI.

* You'll own and play a pivotal role in the development of systems, tools and infrastructure that enable data and data systems powered product use\-cases.

* You'll be responsible for monitoring and operating systems in production. You’ll understand systems deeply, optimize performance and evolve critical production systems with minimal user disruption.

* You’ve had past experience working full\-stack in Typescript and node.js ecosystem
* You have worked on data or infrastructure\-focused engineering teams, particularly ones that own a wide swath of software platforms (hosted or built in\-house). You've experienced the challenges of scaling and re\-architecting event\-based platforms and infrastructure through orders of magnitude of growth and scaling data volume.

 Waymo is a pioneering autonomous driving technology company dedicated to transforming mobility and enhancing safety on the roads. Originating as the Google Self\-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has evolved into a leader in the development of self\-driving vehicles, with a mission to become the world's most trusted driver. The company's flagship innovation, the Waymo Driver, is designed to improve access to transportation, reduce traffic\-related fatalities, and revolutionize the way people and goods move across diverse environments. With over ten million rider\-only trips completed and autonomous vehicles having driven more than 100 million miles on public roads across more than 15 states, Waymo continues to set industry standards for safety, reliability, and technological excellence.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Staff Software Engineer, Planner at Waymo, you will play a critical role in advancing the company's autonomous driving capabilities. Reporting to the Technical Lead Manager, you will collaborate with a talented and innovative team to develop and refine the behavior of our autonomous vehicles, ensuring they operate safely, smoothly, and predictably in complex real\-world scenarios. Your expertise will contribute to solving challenging problems related to motion planning, perception, and decision\-making, enabling the Waymo Driver to handle social interactions, negotiate narrow roads, and manage noisy or incomplete sensor data. This role offers a unique opportunity to work on cutting\-edge robotics and machine learning systems that directly impact public safety and mobility. You will be involved in framing complex open\-ended problems into well\-defined engineering tasks, developing scalable algorithms, and deploying solutions that run efficiently in real\-time on autonomous vehicles.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Minimum of 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience
* Proficiency in C\+\+ programming with a focus on writing efficient, reliable code
* Experience collaborating effectively across multidisciplinary teams
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to translate open\-ended challenges into structured engineering solutions


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related field
* Experience in motion planning or robotics problem\-solving
* Background in developing or evaluating machine learning\-based systems


**Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and optimize motion planning algorithms to ensure safe and smooth vehicle behavior in diverse driving scenarios
